; sleep-rotate.qmd - full-screen sleep picture that changes from sleep to sleep.
; Works with the custom sleep screen: xochitl.conf [General] SleepScreenPath
; points at /home/root/sleepscreen/sleep-1.png. If the path ends with
; "/sleep-<number>.png", the mod swaps the number for the current one.
; The sleep window is created anew for every sleep and keeps nothing, so the
; number comes from the firmware's own Carousel object (root.carousel), which
; the window already gets and which steps through
; /usr/share/remarkable/carousel/sleep_Illustration_0N.png from sleep to sleep:
; illustration N gives picture ((N - 1) % gbaSleepCount) + 1. If the carousel
; path has no number, the current second decides.
; Do not add a QtCore Settings here to keep a counter: on 3.29.1 the sleep
; window then fails to load and the tablet sleeps with a blank screen.
; Pictures: /home/root/sleepscreen/sleep-1.png, sleep-2.png, ... Adding a
; picture means one more file and a new gbaSleepCount below.
; Source: sleep-rotate.qmd.in, encoded by Tools\Remarkable\encode-qmd.py.
; SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only. Built for firmware 3.29.1.

AFFECT [[15136737896827182809]]
    TRAVERSE [[7711468349764991]]#[[6504254477]]
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            property ~&197088788&~ gbaSleepCount: 3
            property ~&7083178290016&~ gbaCarouselPath: ~&6504254477&~.~&7712874732231975&~ ? ("" + ~&6504254477&~.~&7712874732231975&~.~&254533793748405209&~) : ""
            property ~&197088788&~ gbaSleepShown: {
                ~&214622607920&~ dot = ~&6504254477&~.gbaCarouselPath.lastIndexOf(".png");
                ~&214622607920&~ n = dot > 0 ? ~&7713428776113935&~(~&6504254477&~.gbaCarouselPath.~&254548200562243306&~(dot - 1, dot)) : 0;
                ~&5972376&~ (n > 0) {
                    ~&7083121450889&~ (n - 1) % ~&6504254477&~.gbaSleepCount;
                }
                ~&7083121450889&~ ~&6502909715&~.~&214626058827&~(~&6502586279&~.now() / 1000) % ~&6504254477&~.gbaSleepCount;
            }

            ~&254480451320573660&~.~&495334332051582499&~: {
                ~&233724020023100&~.~&197092075&~("sleep-rotate: picture " + (~&6504254477&~.gbaSleepShown + 1) + ", carousel " + ~&6504254477&~.gbaCarouselPath);
            }
        }

        REPLACE [[16364404249624396525]] WITH {
            function ~&16364404249624396525&~() {
                ~&197091758&~ ~&6504167510&~ = ~&6504254477&~.~&254534055152396035&~.~&8043263189855313455&~;
                ~&214622607920&~ cut = ~&6504167510&~.lastIndexOf("/sleep-");
                ~&5972376&~ (cut >= 0 && ~&6504254477&~.gbaSleepCount > 0) {
                    ~&6504167510&~ = ~&6504167510&~.~&254548200562243306&~(0, cut) + "/sleep-" + (~&6504254477&~.gbaSleepShown + 1) + ".png";
                }
                ~&5972376&~ (!~&6504167510&~.~&8400089168236034054&~("file:")) {
                    ~&6504167510&~ = "file://" + ~&6504167510&~;
                }
                ~&7083121450889&~ ~&6504167510&~;
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
